newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: TABLE - HJ Joel June qtr pre-capex net rises.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - HJ Joel June qtr pre-capex net rises.

text.p: Results for the quarter to end-June versus preceding quarter.
Net profit before capital spending 46.15 vs 38.23**
** previous quarter net profit adjusted to reflect apportionment over fiscal year of accrued tax liability on non-mining income
Full name: H.J. Joel Gold Mining Co Ltd, a unit of JCI Ltd
NOTE - The company said the longer term plan for the mine was sound as the new shaft system and the decline project were on target.
The company said it expected to sustain the mine's current performance.

Milling circuit modifications would increase milling capacity to 110,000 tons per month over the next quarter with further modifications planned to bring monthly capacity to 130,000 tons by July 1998.
- The company declared an ordinary dividend of five cents on June 25, payable on August 1.
